name: Why is backer board and waterproofing necessary before tiling a shower?

mainEntity.name: Why is backer board and waterproofing necessary before tiling a shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper waterproofing beneath bathroom tile is essential because tile and grout joints are not completely waterproof on their own. Water can seep through micro-cracks or porous grout, eventually rotting wall studs, swelling subfloors, and creating hidden mold. A proper installation requires cement backer board or specialized waterproof foam boards, combined with a waterproof membrane and sealed seams on shower walls and floors. HH Remodeling focuses on full-scope bathroom renovations and ensures moisture barriers are correctly placed behind the tile before a single piece is set, protecting your home's structural framing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile and grout are naturally porous and let moisture through. A dedicated waterproof membrane and backer board prevent framing rot and hidden mold damage behind walls.
